source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the classes of antibiotic (PDF 209-210).

blocks.text: Antibiotics woh dawaen hain jo bacteria ko maar kar ya un ki barhotri rok kar bacterial infections ka ilaaj karti hain. In ki darja bandi zyada tar asar ke tareeqe aur kimiyai banawat se hoti hai. Chaar bari qismein penicillins, tetracyclines, fluoroquinolones aur sulfonamides hain.

blocks.alt: Bacterial cell jis ki moti hari cell wall, chhalle numa DNA molecule jis par narangi enzyme, jamni ribosomes aur folate likha surkh dabba. Labels: penicillin cell wall par, tetracycline 30S ribosome subunit par, fluoroquinolones DNA gyrase aur topoisomerase IV par, aur sulfonamides folate banne par asar karti hain.
blocks.caption: Chaar antibiotic qismein bacterial cell par kahan asar karti hain (Figure 23.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Antibiotics aise dhaanchon ya amal par asar karti hain jo bacteria mein hain aur insani cells mein nahi ya mukhtalif shakal mein hain. Penicillin bacterial cell wall mein peptidoglycan ke aapas mein jurne ko rokti hai, is liye wall kamzor ho kar cell phat jata hai (bactericidal). Tetracycline bacterial ribosomes ki 30S subunit se jur kar aminoacyl-tRNA ko A site tak pohanchne nahi deti aur protein banna ruk jata hai (bacteriostatic). Fluoroquinolones DNA gyrase aur topoisomerase IV ko phansa kar DNA ke dono strands torti hain (bactericidal). Sulfonamides folate banna rokti hain jo DNA banne ke liye zaroori hai (bacteriostatic). Insani cells ki cell wall nahi, 80S ribosomes hain aur folate khane se lete hain, is liye bache rehte hain.

blocks.caption: Chaar qismon ka muqabla
rows: DNA gyrase aur topoisomerase IV (DNA replication)

blocks.title: Bactericidal aur bacteriostatic
blocks.text: Bactericidal dawa bacteria ko maarti hai; bacteriostatic dawa un ki barhotri aur afzaish rokti hai aur unhein khatam karna immune system par chhorti hai.

blocks.prompt: Antibiotics viruses par kyun kaam nahi karti?
blocks.explanation: Yeh bacteria ke dhaanchon, jaise cell wall, 70S ribosomes aur folate banne, par asar karti hain jo viruses mein nahi hote.

items: Antibiotics bacteria ko maarti (bactericidal) ya rokti (bacteriostatic) hain.
Chaar qismein: penicillin, tetracycline, fluoroquinolones, sulfonamides.
